notes.title: Kaiju Kite Attack - Update 9-01-2020
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35447888/e16a01054f74d82c7e16834c0c6e539743195d59.png

-You have activated Level Completion Invulnerability! Tired of dying after you beat the Boss?!? So are we!! Now you can obliterate that Kaiju soundly and with confidence, without the fear of repercussion from beyond the grave!

Thanks for playing!

-PWCA
